items.reason: This is the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash you asked for, a rinse-off cleanser for breakout-prone areas like the jawline.
A light, mattifying moisturizer to offset dryness from the wash without feeling heavy on oily skin.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily use, to help keep any post-breakout marks from looking darker on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Start by using the wash once a day on damp skin for a minute or two, rinse well, then follow with moisturizer, and add sunscreen in the morning; it can bleach towels and pillowcases, so keep them separate. If you notice stinging or peeling, use the wash every other day, and if breakouts stay stubborn or feel painful, a dermatologist is the better next step than adding more products.
